```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

# Problem 1
```{r function_plot}

birthday_sim = function(n) {
  any(duplicated(sample(1:365, n, replace = TRUE)))
}

set.seed(2026)

birthday_results =
  tibble(n = 2:50) |>
  mutate(
    prob = map_dbl(n, \(x) mean(replicate(10000, birthday_sim(x))))
  )

birthday_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = prob)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Group size",
    y = "Probability of shared birthday"
  )
```
The probability of sharing a birthday increases with group size. When group size is larger than 23, the probability of sharing a birthday reaches 50%.

# Problem 2
```{r import}
subject_files =
  tibble(file = list.files("data", pattern = "\\.csv$")) |>
  mutate(data = map(file, \(x) read_csv(file.path("data", x))))

study_data =
  subject_files |>
  unnest(data) |>
  mutate(
    subject_id = str_remove(file, "\\.csv$"),
    arm = if_else(str_detect(file, "^con"), "Control", "Experimental")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("week_"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "week_",
    values_to = "outcome"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = as.integer(week)) |>
  select(subject_id, arm, week, outcome)
```

```{r spaghetti-plot}
study_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = outcome, group = subject_id)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(~ arm) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Outcome"
  )
```
